sources.name: Gematsu
sources.title: DAVE THE DIVER DLC ‘Subnautica 2 Content Pack’ announced
sources.text: MINTROCKET has announced DAVE THE DIVER ‘s final downloadable content pack—a Subnautica 2 -themed expansion in partnership with Unknown Worlds Entertainment . It will launch free of charge in early 2027. “For our final [downloadable content] expansion, we wanted to create something that felt especially meaningful, and a Subnautica collaboration is what players have been asking us about for a long time,” said MINTROCKET studio director Jaeho Hwang in a press release. “Both games are set underwater, but Subnautica has such a distinct approach to underwater exploration, so working with the Subnautica 2 team gave us a chance to bring a new wave to DAVE THE DIVER experience. We’re really excited for players to see what we’ve been working on, and we hope this collaboration gives them one more fresh and surprising adventure with Dave and his friends, old and new.” Subnautica 2 creative director Anthony Gallegos added, “We’re so excited to collaborate with the team at MINTROCKET. It’s clear that we both adore one another’s games a lot, and the expansion is a love letter to both DAVE THE DIVER and the Subnautica universe. People are in for a treat.” The free expansion will see players explore the strange new waters of Proteus, filled with unfamiliar creatures and valuable resources waiting to be discovered. The upcoming Subnautica 2 Content Pack creates a confluence of mysterious waters unlike anything before, with Dave and Bancho traveling interdimensionally to make new discoveries, unlock strange and exotic recipes, and lend a hand to new friends in need—all while facing periodic confrontations with the perilous Leviathan. DAVE THE DIVER is available now for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series , Switch 2 , PlayStation 4 , Xbox One , Switch , PC via Steam , Epic Games Store , and Microsoft Store , iOS, and Android.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Subnautica 2 fans can finally hunt and kill those pesky Nibbler Mangos—in Dave the Diver's crossover DLC
sources.text: I will kill them. I will cook them. I will serve them. Thanks, Dave. It took a while but there's finally an official way to hunt and kill some of Subnautica 2's most annoying sea creatures. The only catch is, you'll have to do it in Dave the Diver DLC—though as catches go, that's a pretty fun one. The crossover was announced today at the Triple-I Initiative showcase. Coming in early 2027, the Dave the Diver X Subnautica 2 content pack will suck Dave into the alien waters of Unknown Worlds' survival game where he can mine resources, hunt fish, and—one would hope—discover some tasty new sushi recipes for Bancho to cook up. Here's the trailer: What caught my eye even more than the glimpse of a massive and intimidating boss at the end of the trailer were those pesky Nibbler Mangos, which start biting you the second you dive into Subnautica 2 and never really stop. Players having no way to kill large enemies in Subnautica 2 has been a bit of a controversy , with some even resorting to mods so they can fight back. It's nice that players can finally get a bit of revenge against those relentless fish, albeit in another game. "We're thrilled to see Subnautica 2's creatures, including the Nibbler Mango, join Dave's world," Mintrocket told PC Gamer via email. "The team had a lot of fun bringing these creatures into our game, and players can expect the DLC to play just like the Dave the Diver they know and love." As for those saddened to hear this is the final DLC for Dave the Diver, that doesn't necessarily mean it's the definitive end of his adventures. "While this will be the final major DLC for Dave the Diver, there may still be smaller content updates or collaborations based on player feedback and our internal plans," Mintrocket told PC Gamer. "Since we're not moving straight into a sequel, we'll keep thinking about ways to make sure players don't forget Dave and his friends." Bancho the Chef, meanwhile, is getting his own game , a prequel, though a release date has yet to be announced. Chris has a love-hate relationship with survival games and an unhealthy fascination with the inner lives of NPCs. He's also a fan of offbeat simulation games, mods, and ignoring storylines in RPGs so he can make up his own. sources.title: Cyberpunk 2077 live-action film in development at Paramount Pictures [Update]
sources.text: Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action film set in CD Projekt RED ‘s Cyberpunk 2077 universe, according to a Deadline report . G.I. Joe and Transformers film series producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura will produce the movie alongside CD Projekt RED. The film will be set in the Cyberpunk 2077 universe, though specific story details have not been announced. Update 4:00 p.m.: In a tweet , CD Projekt RED co-CEO Michal Nowakowski added, “We’re excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time.”

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film reportedly in development, with CD Projekt Red collaborating with Paramount to make it
sources.text: UPDATE 12PM BST: CD Projekt Red seems to have confirmed the partnership and film, with joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski commenting on X that: "We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time." ORIGINAL STORY 11:40AM BST: A live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film is reportedly in the works at Paramount Pictures. Producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura - a former Warner Bros. exec influential in signing the The Matrix and Harry Potter films, and known for producing the Transformers films - is said to be attached to the project, with CD Projekt Red collaborating. The report comes from Deadline , though the publication had no further information to share than what's above. CD Projekt Red told us it doens't have anything to share beyond what Nowakowski said on X. Believing that CD Projekt Red would venture into live-action film territory doesn't take a stretch of the imagination. The company's Netflix anime partnership on Cyberpunk Edgerunners has been a success, with a second series due to air this month, on 20th October . The first season, released in 2022, was "fantastic", Wes wrote in his Cyberpunk Edgerunners impressions article , and amassed considerable Netflix viewing figures . Live-action adaptations of video game-based series are also becoming increasingly popular, with The Last of Us and Fallout particularly finding wide success. CD Projekt Red being involved with the Cyberpunk 2077 adaptation would also somewhat heal a wound left by not being involved with The Witcher Netflix adaptation. CD Projekt art director Pawel Mileniczuk called this a "missed opportunity" when I talked to him for a Witcher 3 10-year anniversary article last year. Meanwhile, CD Projekt Red is working on Cyberpunk 2 , a project that's in pre-production, but with an expanding team - close to 200 people as of 31st July 2026 - full production doesn't seem far away. The sequel apparently adds a second city alongside the iconic Night City setting, and it's described as being like "Chicago gone wrong". Should the live-action film prove real, and be made, the questions are what story will it tell - the same as in Cyberpunk 2077? - and which actors will play the game's well-known roles? The most famous of those roles is Keanu Reeves' portrayal of Johnny Silverhand, a character who used Reeves' likeness in the game. Could Reeves star in a film adaptation? Cyberpunk 2077 was released in 2021 , and its rocky launch has since become infamous. But CD Projekt Red did extensive work improving the game after release, focusing its efforts around a kind of 2.0 relaunch alongside the game's "remarkable" Phantom Liberty expansion , in 2023. Paramount, meanwhile, recently acquired Warner Bros., and has since reorganised into mega-company Skydance. Activision's former leader Bobby Kotick has been employed on the board of it .

sources.text: The anime series based on the Sucker Punch Productions -developed PlayStation game Ghost of Tsushima: Legends , which was previously planned to debut in 2027, which will now premiere on Crunchyroll in 2028, Aniplex and Crunchyroll announced . Mayumi Saco and Shinya Fukumatsu will join the cast of the show in undisclosed role. Saco previously voiced Tomoe in the original game, while while Fukumatsu is known for portraying Bomb in One-Punch Man . The anime is being directed by Takanobu Mizuno at studio Kamikaze Douga, with Gen Urobuchi writing the story composition and co-writing the script with Renji Oki. New staff members include composer Keiji Inai, sound director Yoshikazu Iwanami, sound editor Yasumasa Koyama, and title calligraphy artist Gyousyou Suzuki. Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is produced by HAYATE in collaboration with Aniplex and PlayStation Productions, with Sony Music serving as music and soundtrack partner.

sources.title: Ghost of Tsushima anime arrives in 2028 as OG game actor joins cast
sources.text: Ghost of Tsushima Legends has been delayed The upcoming Ghost of Tsushima anime has received a disappointing release date update alongside news of new cast and behind-the-scenes arrivals. At New York Comic Con, Crunchyroll revealed that Ghost of Tsushima Legends is now set for 2028, a slight pushback from its original 2027 window. Two actors, Mayumi Skco and Shinya Fukumatsu, were also confirmed to join the cast. If you've played Ghost of Tsushima in Japanese, you may recognize Saco's voice – she portrayed turncoat villain Tomoe in 2020's Ghost of Tsushima game. It is unknown who the pair will be portraying in Legends, however. Ghost of Tsushima is a 2020 open world adventure charting the revenge journey of Jin Sakai on the Japanese island of Tsushima during feudal times. It was followed up in 2024 by Ghost of Yotei, offering players a new quest as the katana-wielding Atsu hunted down the fearsome Yotei Six after the murder of her parents. In truth, we probably should have expected the delay. We've heard precious little about Ghost of Tsushima Legends since its announcement way back in January 2025. "The Ghost of Tsushima anime will offer fans an exciting new way to experience the game in an anime style that will be bold and groundbreaking," Crunchyroll president Rahul Purini, said at the time in a statement. PlayStation Productions head Asad Qizilbash added, "Ghost of Tsushima’s rich, immersive world and its fantastical Legends mode based on Japanese mythology provide the perfect canvas for this project, and Aniplex is the perfect partner to translate Sucker Punch Productions’ hit video game into a stunning new anime series." sources.title: After Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, Daredevil star Charlie Cox is in a new Sega game
sources.text: After dipping his toes into gaming with Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, Daredevil star Charlie Cox says he's working on an upcoming Sega game. After over 20 years of acting, Cox finally made his game debut in 2025's Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 as lead character Gustave. And despite only spending four hours working on the French JRPG (or J'RPG if you will), the game blew up and unexpectedly became one of his most beloved roles in the long acting career. On top of that, the Cox noted that the game "has seemingly opened a new avenue for my professional work" as he confirmed he was working on another game earlier this year. At New York Comic Con 2026, Cox spoke to IGN (below) and revealed a little more about his upcoming game, explaining, "I did another one, it doesn't have a name yet," and revealing that "I did a Sega one." He adds: "It hasn't come out yet but it was fun to do." Cox continues, "It's hard. It's a whole different job," explaining, "I had to do, like, 40 hours," which is obviously a bit more intensive than his four hours on Clair Obscur. With it not even having a name, naturally details are scarce, but Cox shares an amusing anecdote that maybe shines a bit more light on the game. "I showed up for the first day, and I was like, 'Hi guys, nice to meet you! How are you?' And all of them went, '...oh, he's English.'" He adds, "they wanted him to be American, but like, now I've got to do 40 hours of lines I've not prepared in an accent." It being so early that it doesn't have a name yet means it's probably something we don't even know about; which is to say RPG fans hoping for Cox to bless Persona 6 with a performance are probably out of luck. Given how much RGG Studio loves casting celebrity actors, I can imagine the studio casting Cox in an upcoming game. With Cox having an American accent in Daredevil, a TV show where he plays a lawyer, I'd maybe have to speculate that perhaps a return of the Judgment series could be in the cards? A year later, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 and Daredevil star Charlie Cox has finally played the hit J'RPG: "I'm not very good at it." sources.title: Is GTA 6 Coming To Switch 2? Ask Rockstar, Nintendo Says

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: GTA 6 on Switch 2? 'That's a Conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar,' Nintendo Says
sources.text: Nintendo of America president Devon Pritchard recently spoke about the company's plans, from theme parks to first- and third-party games. And with the launch of Switch 2, the door is open to more third-party games that previously skipped Nintendo consoles (Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is one example). So what about GTA 6? The Switch 2 is of course more powerful than its predecessor, capable of running games like Cyberpunk 2077 and the recent The Witcher 3 remaster. But could it run GTA 6? And, if so, will Rockstar Games release a Switch 2 port? After all, it's coming out on the less powerful Xbox Series S next month. “That’s going to be a conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time,” Pritchard told Variety when asked about GTA 6 on Switch 2. Bah! Rockstar games Red Dead Redemption, Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition, and L.A. Noire are already on Switch, but the developer hasn’t announced anything about Red Dead Redemption 2, never mind GTA 6. Would Manhunt be asking too much? Rockstar’s sequel, Manhunt 2 , famously featured platform-specific controls for pummeling in heads with the motion controllers, and that’d work nicely on Switch 2 and make any onlookers afraid of taking me on when I play it on the train. “We have historically said that Nintendo is for ages 5 to 95, and that continues to be true,” Pritchard said. “We want to provide a diversity in terms of the types of experiences that you can have on the game system, and that’s really important for us.” Nintendo’s upcoming The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launches on November 5, just two weeks before the launch of GTA 6. It’s about as close to Rockstar’s launch any triple-A game has dared, but Nintendo knows it has a captive audience of dedicated fans who love its stuff. A recent SNL skit parodied the double-bill gaming launches , calling it video games’ Barbenheimer. The one-two punch of Zelda and GTA 6 toward the end of the year really tops off a fantastic year in video games. We’ve had good friend times with Big Walk , industry leading combat in Onimusha: Way of the Sword , the first essential Bond game since GoldenEye with 007: First Light , the tantalising tactics and deep social mechanics of Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Wave , and loads more. It feels like we’re at that time in the console cycle where the developers have learned how to get the most out of the machines, and now we’re seeing what everyone can really do. Now Rockstar just needs to prove it’s the wizard it is and squeeze GTA 6 onto Switch 2 so we can play it on the loo. Please, Rockstar. I need this. On the loo. Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

sources.title: Will GTA 6 Ever Come To Switch 2? Nintendo Of America President Says Go Ask Rockstar
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 Switch 2 Grand Theft Auto 6 is the most anticipated gaming release ever and it won’t be on Switch 2, at least not at launch or possibly ever. Asked about the possibility of an eventual port, Nintendo of America president Devon Pritchard suggested it wasn’t up to her. âThatâs going to be a conversation for Take Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time,â Pritchard told Variety in a new interview. In addition to being the only modern gaming console not getting GTA 6 this fall, Switch 2 is also the only console getting a first-party exclusive that’s going head-to-head with Rockstar’s open world juggernaut. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake will arrive just two weeks ahead of time on November 5. But even if it remains a mystery whether the Switch 2 is even capable of satisfactorily running GTA 6 , there are other games Rockstar could be porting to Nintendo’s newest device. Red Dead Redemption 2 still isn’t available on the handheld hybrid, despite coming to the last-gen PlayStation 4 and Xbox Series X/S. GTA 5 hasn’t been ported either. Virtuous, which ported Rockstar’s L.A. Noire to Switch, would love to take on the challenge. â[The] team is eager to adapt Grand Theft Auto 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 for the Nintendo Switch,â technical director Fong told Pocket Tactics . âWeâre personally big fans and believe these games can shine again on the Switch, delighting even more players.â Those open-world games are two of only four top selling games of all time that aren’t available on Switch 2. The others are PUBG and Wii Sports . A successor to the later, Nintendo Switch Sports Resort , arrives on October 22. Bolstering the case for Rockstar getting GTA 5 on Switch 2, especially if GTA 6 i s a no-go, is the fact that GTA Online remains massively popular and Rockstar has yet to reveal plans for sunsetting it anytime soon. For Switch 2 fans who are pining for some some Vice City madness this November, well, there’s always the G rand Theft Auto: The Trilogy â The Definitive Edition . That one is on Nintendo’s console.
